auth_scheme: Bearer (IBM_GUARDRAILS_AUTH_TOKEN); base_url is operator-supplied (NO default) -- IBM FMS Guardrails is operator-deployed
install_tell: Two modes: detector-server (/api/v1/text/contents, batch-capable per-message), orchestrator (/api/v2/text/detection/content). Operator picks via is_detector_server flag. detector_id selects PII / jailbreak / content-safety models.
misconfig_patterns: verify_ssl=False is documented as configurable; operators self-signing on internal infra disable TLS verification and expose token-in-transit.

OSS detector server can be deployed flat with no auth bearer enforced if operator ships with empty IBM_GUARDRAILS_AUTH_TOKEN -- detector ingestion endpoint then becomes unauthenticated text-content scanner (DoS amplifier + free model inference).
Per-model HuggingFace weights pulled at deploy time; supply-chain surface on first run.

active_probe.notes: Operator deployment; identity-fingerprint, do not exfiltrate

deployment_tells: Commercial: watsonx.governance lives on cloud.ibm.com; not the same surface as the OSS detector server
No vendor-baked apex; operator-deployed -- threat surface is in customer deployments
